citation: Garson JA, Badru S, Parker E, Tedder RS, McClure MO. Highly sensitive and specific detection of the SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant by double-mismatch allele-specific real time reverse transcription PCR
what_it_anchors: what a deliberate second mismatch is worth on real samples: the Ct gap between the matching and the non-matching allele-specific reaction
claim: In the 4 of 42 samples with any cross-reaction the gap is 14.3-18.8 cycles; in the other 38 the non-matching reaction gives no Ct at all, so the margin is unbounded rather than 'about 17 cycles'
claim_kind: measured Ct gap on clinical samples; not a synthetic-template efficiency
